headline: Marban Hollow Shifts as Nevish Line Grinds On
war_summary: The latest returns shift the ledger since the last edition, with Marban Hollow quickening to four changes in two hours and seventeen in the day about Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall, now standing one Warden, six Colonial and one neutral, while Linn Mercy stirs again with one change in two hours and thirteen in the day about Lathair and Outwich Ranch for none Warden, ten Colonial and one neutral. The Nevish Line remains the heaviest wire at five changes in two hours and seventy in the day about Blackcoat Way, Grief Mother and Princefal, holding seven Warden and one Colonial after 6,387 Colonial and 7,406 Warden casualties in the day, and the Weathered Expanse follows with four in two hours and forty-eight in the day about Crow's Nest, Wightwalk and Spirit Watch for seven Warden and two neutral. Kuura Strand and Stlican Shelf have gone quiet in the last two hours after seventeen and four changes in the day, while fresh turns appear at Stonecradle about The Reach and at Farranac Coast about Transient Valley, and Callahan's Passage and the Deadlands spend heavy casualties without a recorded flip.
